title: Manager-Accounts
jobDescription:
The Senior Accounts Manager will be responsible for end-to-end financial management of Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), ensuring transparency, compliance, and effective coordination during operational and financial handovers. The role requires strong expertise in budgeting, audits, fund management, and stakeholder engagement with RWAs.

Key Responsibilities

1. RWA Accounts Management

  • Manage and oversee complete accounting operations for RWAs across projects.

  • Ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts, ledgers, and statutory records.

  • Monitor financial transitions during HOTO (EM to RWA), ensuring compliance and transparency.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

  • Prepare annual budgets (OPEX & CAPEX) in coordination with site teams.

  • Track budget vs actuals and highlight variances with corrective actions.

  • Support long-term financial planning including reserve and corpus fund management.

3. Statement of Accounts (SOA) & Reporting

  • Prepare and present detailed Statement of Accounts (SOA) for RWAs.

  • Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

  • Provide actionable insights to management and RWAs for financial decision-making.

4. Fund Management (Sinking / Corpus / Maintenance Funds)

  • Manage settlement of sinking fund, corpus fund, and other reserves with RWAs.

  • Lead discussions with RWAs for financial closures, reconciliation, and final settlements.

  • Ensure adherence to agreed terms and minimize financial escalations.

5. Audit Planning & Compliance

  • Plan and coordinate internal and external audits for RWA accounts.

  • Ensure readiness of financial documents and compliance with audit requirements.

  • Address audit observations and implement corrective actions.

6. Expense Control & Cost Optimization

  • Monitor monthly expenses across sites and ensure cost control.

  • Review vendor payments and validate expense justifications.

  • Identify opportunities for cost optimization without impacting service quality.

7. Stakeholder Management (RWA Interface)

  • Act as the primary finance interface for RWAs.

  • Conduct regular meetings with RWAs to review accounts, budgets, and financial issues.

  • Handle escalations related to financial matters, ensuring timely resolution.

8. Team Management

  • Lead and manage the accounts team across multiple sites.

  • Provide guidance, training, and performance monitoring.

  • Ensure adherence to SOPs, timelines, and quality standards.

9. Site Visits & Operational Support

  • Regularly visit sites to review financial practices and support site teams.

  • Guide estate and facility teams on financial processes and controls.

  • Ensure alignment between site operations and financial governance.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, and compliance

  • Experience in RWA / housing society accounting is mandatory

  • Expertise in budgeting, financial analysis, and reporting

  • Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills

  • Ability to handle audits and complex financial reconciliations

  • Leadership and team management capabilities

  • Proficiency in accounting software / ERP systems

Key Success Metrics

  • Timely closure of financial handovers (HOTO)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of SOA and reports

  • Reduction in financial escalations from RWAs

  • Audit compliance and closure of observations

  • Effective cost control and budget adherence

Alignment to the Function

This role is critical in ensuring smooth financial transition and sustained operational credibility with RWAs, particularly during high-volume handovers and large township managementaligned to estates & CCS operational excellence

title: Dy.General Manager-Customer Care Services
jobDescription:
This role is responsible for managing the complete customer handover process for completed residential apartments or projects, from readiness confirmation to final possession and post-handover support. The position ensures that each unit is inspected, snags are identified and closed, documentation is complete, and customers receive a smooth, transparent, and professionally managed possession experience. The role requires close coordination with project, QA/QC, MEP, CRM, legal, collections, customer service, facility management, and estate teams to ensure timely handover, defect-free delivery, and effective customer grievance resolution within agreed timelines.

Purpose of the Role

The purpose of this role is to ensure that every customer receives a completed, safe, compliant, and ready-to-use apartment at the time of possession. The role acts as a bridge between the customer and internal departments, ensuring

that all technical, commercial, documentation, and service-related requirements are completed before and after handover.

Scope of Work

  • Manage pre-handover readiness checks for apartments, common areas, amenities, infrastructure, and essential services.

  • Coordinate snag identification, tracking, de-snagging, reinspection, and closure with the project and support teams.

  • Handle customer walkthroughs, possession formalities, handover kits, key handover, and acknowledgement documentation.

  • Maintain accurate records in CRM, SFDC, C4C, Qwikspec, MIS trackers, or any other applicable system.

  • Support post-handover issue resolution, customer grievance management, escalation handling, and service improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, and execute unit handovers with internal teams.

  • Conduct pre-handover inspections to confirm unit readiness, specifications, quality, and customer experience.

  • Identify, document, follow up, and close snags within agreed timelines.

  • Coordinate with construction, QA/QC, MEP, project, legal, collections, CRM, customer service, and facility management teams for seamless execution.

  • Verify statutory approvals, completion certificates, CRM clearances, and required handover documents.

  • Monitor the readiness of apartments, common areas, amenities, infrastructure, and essential services before possession.

Customer Interaction and Documentation

  • Manage customer walkthroughs, inspection formalities, registration coordination, and final handover documentation.

  • Brief customers on unit specifications, handover documents, key lists, defect liability period, maintenance norms, and applicable guidelines.

  • Record customer grievances, queries, snag lists, and handover status accurately in CRM, SFDC, C4C, or other applicable systems.

  • Document customer communications, commitments, and handover interactions for tracking and future reference.

  • Capture customer feedback and support service improvement initiatives to enhance satisfaction.

Coordination and Reporting

  • Coordinate with project, CRM, sales, legal, collections, QA, MEP, facility management, and estate teams to resolve handover-related issues.

  • Track handover progress, pending snags, escalations, and customer complaints against agreed timelines.

  • Prepare and share MIS reports on handover status, snag closure, grievances, and escalation ageing.

  • Escalate unresolved or critical matters to relevant stakeholders for timely intervention and closure.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Strong customer service, communication, and relationship management skills.

  • Sound knowledge of residential handover, snagging, quality checks, and possession processes.

  • Ability to coordinate across teams and follow up effectively until closure.

  • Working knowledge of CRM, SFDC, C4C, MIS reporting, and grievance tracking systems.

  • Professional approach to problem-solving and escalation management.

  • High attention to detail in documentation, compliance, and customer commitments.

Expected Outcomes

  • Timely and well-coordinated apartment handovers.

  • Improved zero-snag or minimum-snag handover performance.

  • Complete documentation and tracking of customer interactions and issues.

  • Customer grievances resolved within agreed TATs.

  • Improved customer satisfaction during possession and post-handover support.

title: Dy. Manager - Legal
jobDescription:
Role Purpose

To provide end-to-end legal support for commercial contracting with a primary focus on office and retail leasing transactions, ensuring strong risk mitigation, enforceability, and alignment with business objectives. The role will involve drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing complex lease documentation and related commercial agreements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Commercial Leasing & Documentation

  • Draft, review, and negotiate lease deeds, agreements to lease, leave & license agreements, renewals, amendments, and termination agreements for office and retail assets.
  • Structure and vet retail mall documentation, including occupier agreements, fit-out agreements, CAM agreements, and signage rights.
  • Ensure documentation is legally robust, commercially aligned, and lessor-favourable, with clear allocation of risks and obligations.

2. Contract Management

  • Handle a wide range of commercial contracts, including:
    • Service provider agreements
    • Facility management agreements
    • Power supply / utilities agreements
    • Marketing and branding arrangements
  • Develop and standardise templates, clauses, and playbooks to improve efficiency and consistency.

3. Negotiation & Deal Support

  • Actively participate in commercial negotiations with tenants, retailers, and counterparties.
  • Provide pragmatic legal solutions balancing risk and business requirements.
  • Support business teams in deal structuring and closure timelines.

4. Risk Mitigation & Compliance

  • Identify and mitigate legal risks in leasing and commercial arrangements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, including:
    • Transfer of Property Act
    • Stamp laws and registration requirements
    • RERA (where applicable)
    • Local municipal and development regulations
  • Review and advise on insurance, indemnity, liability, and exit provisions.

5. Dispute Management Support

  • Assist in handling tenant disputes, defaults, and enforcement actions, including termination and repossession.
  • Coordinate with external counsel where required.
  • Draft notices for breach, termination, and recovery.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leasing, asset management, finance, projects, and facility teams.
  • Provide timely legal inputs on business proposals and operational issues.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong expertise in commercial leasing (office and retail).
  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to provide solution-oriented, business-friendly legal advice.
  • High level of ownership, responsiveness, and stakeholder management.
  • Strong understanding of real estate laws and regulatory framework in India.

Qualifications & Experience

  • LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • 7–10+ years of experience in real estate / commercial contracts, preferably with a real estate developer, law firm, or corporate legal team.
  • Demonstrated experience in handling large-scale office and retail leasing transactions.

Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to mall leasing / retail portfolio management.
  • Experience in standardisation of legal documents and processes.
  • Familiarity with multi-city leasing operations.
